caption: The broker's schedule for the 800 CPU-hour job: for the first 4 hours all three sites run, and site B's 100 CPUs alone give 400 CPU-hours before B leaves. From 4 to 6.67 h the remaining 60 CPUs supply the last 160 CPU-hours, so the job finishes at 6.67 h, inside the 12 h deadline.

spec.aria: A timeline with one lane per grid site: from 0 to 4 hours site A runs 40 CPUs, site B runs 100 CPUs and site C runs 20 CPUs, totalling 640 CPU-hours; site B then stops, and from 4 to 6.67 hours sites A and C run 60 CPUs to finish the last 160 CPU-hours of the 800 CPU-hour job.
